entities.summary: Artūrs Mārtiņš Žagars is a Latvian professional basketball player for Fenerbahçe of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroLeague. Standing at 1.90 m, he primarily plays at the point guard position.
